name: Hanatsuki Rekka
source:
Second year student at St. Trea Academy. A member of the puzzle club. She is a cheerful and erotic girl. She is a typical extroverted girl, and always hangs out with her female friends after school. 

Her hobbies are fashion and karaoke. She hates studying and her grades are the worst. Instead of asking the protagonist to help her with her studies, she joins the puzzle club at his request. 

•[b]Boob Shape[/b]
[b]Hemispherical[/b]
